name: Cryptomator
summary: Cryptomator encrypts files on the user's device before they go to cloud storage. The individual plan is free for personal use. Cryptomator Hub adds zero-knowledge key management and user and group management for teams. Hub Enterprise is listed from EUR 10,000 a year, excluding VAT, for at least 50 seats. Hub Standard is billed per seat with a minimum of three seats, and its page shows no numeric price.

facts.text: On the pricing page, Cryptomator encrypts files on the user's device before they are stored in cloud storage.
Pricing page: Cryptomator Hub adds zero-knowledge key management to Cryptomator.
Pricing page: Hub includes user and group management, and only users granted access to vaults count toward the seat limit.
Hub Enterprise is listed from EUR 10,000 a year, excluding VAT, starting at 50 seats, with emergency access and a dedicated account manager, per the pricing page.
Hub Community is free, self-hosted, with five seats, and Hub Standard has a 30-day free trial, per the pricing page.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Free for personal use with unlimited vaults and full Desktop access.

plans.name: Hub Enterprise

hiddenCosts: Optional upgrades for Android, iOS and Dark Mode on Desktop are one-time purchases at EUR 29.99 each, according to the pricing page.
Hub Standard charges for every seat, including unused seats.
